name: Ember Doctrine
legend: Hold the line and the line holds you.
description: Each time a model from your army with the Ember Resolve ability makes a melee attack while within range of an objective marker, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

name: Tide Instinct
description: Each time a VERDANT SWARM unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, if it is within 6" of a friendly Swarm Seer, re-roll a wound roll of 1.
